correctness.rationale: The proof classifies every filtration-generated simplex from the unique-earlier-neighbor criterion, proves the exact join and the two types of hub-apex links for all p,q>=1, then performs actual relative simplicial collapses for q>=2. For q=1 the remaining two links are wedges of two p-spheres and their attaching maps vanish since the base is p-connected; the resulting wedge equivalence is integral. Polynomial face counts follow from a disjoint, exhaustive cone decomposition. Standalone exhaustive small-case checks verify complete face sets, polynomial coefficients, mod-two homology, and 256 elementary relative collapse pairs for (p,q)=(1,2). Finite tests do not substitute for the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The interaction of triangles and squares meeting at a vertex is a motivated missing family between previously classified boundary axes. The theorem provides complete integral homotopy for all positive p,q, a sharp two-square rank transition with fixed 3^p summand count in the stable range, a stronger simple-homotopy collapse, and the full face enumerator. This is a structural two-parameter classification, not a numerical recalculation or a routine one-case increment.
